name: gtm-ide
description: Drover — the founder-controlled Product and go-to-market system.
author: Drover

scripts.postinstall: node electron/prepare-node-pty.cjs && npm --prefix brain install && npm --prefix ui install
scripts.test: npm --prefix brain test && npm --prefix ui run test:unit && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.test:electron: npm run prepare:pty && npm --prefix ui run build -- --configLoader runner && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-force-exit electron/window-state.test.cjs electron/terminal-runtime.test.cjs electron/preview-runtime.test.cjs test/browser/native-coding-electron.mjs
scripts.test:firm:browser: npm --prefix ui run build -- --configLoader runner && node --test test/browser/firm-journey.mjs
scripts.test:canvas:browser: npm --prefix ui run build -- --configLoader runner && node --test test/browser/canvas-journey.mjs
scripts.test:firm:acceptance-browser: npm --prefix ui run build -- --configLoader runner && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-force-exit test/browser/firm-journey.mjs test/browser/return-journey.mjs test/browser/dense-journey.mjs test/browser/wall-journey.mjs test/browser/canvas-journey.mjs test/browser/native-coding-journey.mjs test/browser/workspace-modes-journey.mjs
scripts.test:atlas:browser: npm --prefix ui run build -- --configLoader runner && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-force-exit test/browser/atlas-journey.mjs test/browser/atlas-density-journey.mjs test/browser/atlas-accessibility-journey.mjs
scripts.test:atlas:a11y-browser: npm --prefix ui run build -- --configLoader runner && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-force-exit test/browser/atlas-accessibility-journey.mjs
scripts.test:acceptance: npm test && npm --prefix design-system run verify:tokens && npm run test:firm:acceptance-browser && npm run test:atlas:browser && npm run test:electron
scripts.build:desktop: npm run prepare:pty && npm run build
